hero.title: AEO Glossary
hero.subtitle: Understand each term and know what to do about it.
hero.description: Find a definition, see an example, and check what it means for your content.

editorial.method: Sources explain the underlying concepts, and each example is an illustration we wrote for this glossary, so none of them describe a client. Practical checks are editorial recommendations, and where a definition covers reporting, it states the counting rules we use, which other tools may set differently. Definitions are researched with AI assistance and reviewed by Content Cucumber's editors before they are published.
